# 75154 - Quadruple line receiver (EIA RS-232-C)

Package DIP-16 · family 751xx · catalogue file [catalog/chips/75154.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/75154.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 44 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![75154 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/75154.png) | ![75154 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/line-driver1.png) | ![75154 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/line-driver1.png) |

A large open triangle pointing right with one input.

How to tell it on a drawing: Big triangle, one input. The manual heads it 'Line driver', but the 75154 is a quadruple line RECEIVER in every datasheet found (TI 1974 and 1995, National DS75154), and sheet 2A50 uses it as a receiver; the manual's label is kept here as printed and taken to be a slip (see catalog/chips/75154.json).

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 13,12,11,10 | Y = NOT A (with hysteresis: low when A &gt; VT+, high when A &lt; VT-, else holds) | Datasheet logic Y = A'. Inverting RS-232-C receiver with active pull-up output. In fail-safe mode (threshold control open) an open or zero input gives a high output. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: input crossing a threshold (hysteresis)

- Normal operation (T pin to VCC1): output goes low when A rises above VT+ (0.8 min, 2.2 typ, 3 max V), high when A falls below VT- (-3 min, -1.1 typ, 0 max V); between, output keeps its previous level; input at 0 V keeps the previous level
- Fail-safe operation (T pin open): VT+ 0.8/2.2/3 V, VT- 0.8/1.4/3 V (both above zero); open or 0 V input gives output high
- Hysteresis VT+ - VT-: normal 0.8/3.3/6 V, fail-safe 0/0.8/2.2 V

| notes | VCC1 4.5-5.5 V (or VCC2 10.8-13.2 V), TA 0-70 C. Input voltage range +/-15 V recommended (+/-25 V absolute). Input resistance 3-7 kohm. Open-circuit input voltage 0-2 V. VOH min 2.4 V at IOH -400 uA, VOL max 0.4 V at IOL 16 mA (these are test conditions; the recommended conditions give fan-out N = 10). VIH 3 V, VIL -3 V. |

## Not known

- Only typical delays are printed; no min or max.
- IOL/IOH are taken from the VOL/VOH test conditions; the recommended conditions give fan-out N = 10 instead.

## Notes

ND-13.003.01 page 44 labels this part 'Line driver'. Every datasheet found (TI 1974, TI 1995, National DS75154) calls it a quadruple line receiver and no 75154 sold as a driver was found, so the manual's label is taken as a slip on that one entry (the 75150 above it is a driver). NORD-10 sheet 2A50 uses two 75154 as receivers for the modem's incoming signals. Y = NOT A agrees with the datasheet logic.
